behavioral_notes.observation: Materialises product.product variants as the cartesian product of valid attribute lines: for attributes with create_variant='always' it instantiates every combination immediately, for 'dynamic' it skips creation (variants are spawned on demand by the configurator), and for 'no_variant' the attribute never produces variants. Guarded by a 'product.dynamic_variant_limit' (default 1000). This template->variant explosion is pure Python, invisible in metadata.

A variant's price_extra is computed as the sum of price_extra over its product_template_attribute_value_ids; lst_price = template.list_price + price_extra (uom-context dependent). So the per-variant sales price is assembled from per-attribute-value surcharges held on product.template.attribute.value, not stored on the variant.

Resolves a unit price per rule by compute_price mode: 'fixed' returns fixed_price, 'percentage' applies percent_price to a base price, and 'formula' applies discount/markup, rounding (price_round), surcharge, and min/max margin clamps against a configurable base ('list_price', 'standard_price' or another pricelist). _compute_price_rule selects the most specific applicable rule (variant > template > category > global) by date/quantity. The pricing engine is entirely in Python.

15 JS files, 8 XML templates, 4 OWL components (ProductCatalogOrderLine, ProductNameAndDescriptionField, ProductPricelistReport, UploadButton), 4 registry registrations, 0 patches; asset bundles web.assets_backend (6), web.report_assets_common (1), web.assets_unit_tests (1).

information_flows: side-effect: product.template._create_variant_ids -> generates product.product variants from attribute combinations
side-effect: product.pricelist.item._compute_price -> resolves applied unit price consumed by sale/purchase/pos

value_streams: Define-to-Catalog: define product template -> add attributes -> generate variants -> set list/cost price & pricelists -> publish for sale/purchase
policies: 6 record rules: multi-company scoping on products, pricelists and pricelist rules
applied_on precedence (variant > template > category > global) governing pricelist rule selection

classification.apqc_category: 2.0 Develop and Manage Products and Services
classification.rationale: product is master-data foundation: it defines the product/variant/attribute/pricelist information concepts that the value chain (sale, purchase, stock, mrp), the shop (services/timesheets) and the network (pos/website) all consume. It does not itself transform demand or run an operational document flow; it is a firm-infrastructure support activity (Stabell & Fjeldstad support) feeding every primary activity. product.template is a core Information Concept depended on by base, mail and uom downstream consumers.

standard_capabilities: product template/variant model with attributes & exclusions
pricelists with fixed/percentage/formula rules and applied_on precedence
typical_fits: standard catalog of goods/services with variants
multi-company product scoping via record rules
common_gaps: complex configurable-product rules beyond attribute exclusions
bespoke pricing formulas beyond fixed/percentage/formula modes
